items.question: Is my donation tax-deductible?
items.answer: Yes. Sunshine on a Ranney Day is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 45-4773997). You'll receive a tax receipt from Zeffy immediately after donating. If you do not receive a receipt, please email us at info@soardcharity.com

items.question: Does 100% of my donation really go to kids?
items.answer: Yes. Zeffy is a 100% free platform for nonprofits and charges zero processing fees. Your entire donation goes directly to funding room materials, labor, and design for children's spaces.

items.question: Can I set up a monthly recurring donation?
items.answer: Absolutely. In the donation form above, simply toggle to "Monthly" before selecting your amount. Monthly gifts help us plan future room makeovers with greater confidence.

items.question: Can I donate materials or services instead?
items.answer: Yes! We partner with contractors, designers, and suppliers across Atlanta. Visit our Get Involved page to learn about partnership opportunities.

items.question: How much does a typical room makeover cost?
items.answer: The cost of each makeover varies depending on the scope of the project. Dream bedrooms typically range from $10,000–$15,000, wheelchair-accessible bathrooms average $35,000–$40,000, and in-home therapy rooms generally range from $20,000–$30,000. Every dollar donated goes directly toward creating these life-changing spaces for the children and families we serve.

items.question: What is Sunshine on a Ranney Day?
items.answer: Sunshine on a Ranney Day (SOARD) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that provides life-changing home makeovers — dream bedrooms, accessible bathrooms, and therapy rooms — for children with special needs in the greater Atlanta area, all at no cost to families.

items.question: How long has SOARD been operating?
items.answer: SOARD began in 2012 when we first helped Matthew. To learn more about that project, please visit the "About Us" section.

items.question: Who runs the organization?
items.answer: SOARD was co-founded by Peter and Holly Ranney who continue to run the organization daily. Our team includes dedicated volunteers, board members, and a network of construction and design partners. Visit our Leadership page to meet the team.

items.question: What types of rooms do you build?
items.answer: We build three types of spaces: dream bedrooms designed around a child's interests, accessible bathrooms that promote independence, and therapy rooms for at-home physical or occupational therapy.

items.question: How long does a room makeover take?
items.answer: Most rooms are completed in 8-10 weeks during a scheduled build. The planning and design phase typically takes 4–6 weeks before the build.

items.question: Who actually builds the rooms?
items.answer: Our rooms are built by a combination of licensed contractors, professional designers, and skilled volunteers. Every project is managed to ensure safety and quality.

items.question: How do families apply for a room makeover?
items.answer: Families can apply through our Application page. We accept applications year-round and select children based on need and available resources.

items.question: Who qualifies for a room makeover?
items.answer: We serve children with special needs (physical, developmental, or medical) in the greater Atlanta area. Families must demonstrate financial need and own their home.

items.question: Is there any cost to the family?
items.answer: None. Every room makeover is provided completely free of charge to the family. All materials, labor, and design are funded through donations and partnerships.
